doc.title: Eddie Miller and Pete Fountain Interview, 1970-01-09

title: Eddie on the Crosby alumni band
summary: Eddie says Haggart and Lawson lead a World's Greatest Jazz Band with a Crosby-like sound.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: I'd like to ask Mr. Miller a question. Aren't some of your old friends from the Bob Crosby days back together again, and don't they have a band playing somewhere in New York?
Yes, they do. They call themselves Bob Haggart, Yank Lawson, greatest, world's greatest jazz band.
Are they playing at the Plaza they're playing now?
No, they were playing at the Roosevelt Grill, I think, now they, I think they open in Vegas on the 15th of this month.
Well, Guy Lombardo's all hang out, isn't it?
I understand there's a chance that band may come back to Al Hurt's club soon. That's what I heard, yes.
Yes, now, are they still playing somewhat in the Bobcat style, would you say?
Yes, that's right, because Bob Haggart is playing bass, and he's doing quite a bit of the arranging, and it has a similar sound to the Crosby band, I think.
Yeah, quite a few of them.
